repairs.before: Consider—even in the well-governed age of Tang and Yu, in instructing Shun and Yu they earnestly took as a warning: "When the four seas are destitute, Heaven's blessings will end forever."
repairs.after: Consider—even in the well-governed age of Tang and Yu [Shun's polity], in instructing Shun and Yu they earnestly took as a warning: "When the four seas are destitute, Heaven's blessings will end forever."
repairs.reason: Primary Chinese 唐、虞治平之世 pairs Yao's Tang (唐) with Shun's You/Yu polity (虞, 有虞氏), not Yu the Great (禹). The same sentence later names 舜、禹 separately; the literal English opening must not read 虞 as the flood-controller Yu.
